reduce-to-circuit:
(program (kernel-declaration (%kernel.2 () (Kernel)))
  (public-ledger-declaration
    ((%pk.0 (0) (__compact_Cell (tfield)))))
  (native %degradeToTransient.3 ((%x.4 (tbytes 32))) (tfield))
  (witness %secretKey.5 () (tbytes 32))
  (circuit %set.1 () (ttuple) (= #t %t.7 (call %secretKey.5))
    (= #t %tmp.6 (call %degradeToTransient.3 %t.7))
    (= #t %t.8 (public-ledger %pk.0 (0) write %tmp.6))
    (= #t %t.9 (tuple)) %t.9))
